coverage_notes: Markets come from the market list at fetch time; a market delisted before that is absent (Upbit serves no candles for it): survivor-only.
A slot without trades has no candle and no row; gaps are not filled.
market_warning/caution flags in market_all.json are the state at fetch time, not point in time.
note: Raw candle files stay outside git. The full manifest (with the sha256 of every response page) is in the artifact directory; this file keeps file hashes and row counts.
